The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Blurs Into a Cloud of Drudgery

Just when you think there’s no more life in a franchise, an executive somewhere puts a crowbar in the crypt and revives an old moneymaker for one more round. The first four Hunger Games movies, released from 2012 to 2015 and adapted from Suzanne Collins’ enormously successful young-adult novels , featured Jennifer Lawrence as the ever-plucky Katniss Everdeen.
